comments: Per-model translation settings for scripts/translate.py, looked up by full model name, then the name without its tag, then "default"; a model entry overrides default keys (options merge key by key). prompt: "instruct" (system prompt, earlier chunks as chat turns), "translategemma" (its fixed published format) or "hy-mt" (Tencent Hy-MT2 published templates in one user turn: background information, "X translates to Y" terminology, tag retention). chunk_chars: largest request, in source characters. batch: pack consecutive paragraphs into one request as <segN> tags. context_chars: source characters of preceding chunks replayed with their translations. glossary: extract recurring names and dictionary-unknown words once per book, translate them, and give each request the entries it contains (saved as <output>.glossary.json; edit and rerun to correct). think: Ollama thinking level or false. retry_temperature: sampling for the one retry after a markup failure. Entries for qwen3.8:latest, hy-mt2:latest, qwen3.6:35b-a3b-nvfp4 and gemma4:26b-a4b were chosen on 2026-10-06 from a grid over 21 paragraphs of The Cosmic Serpent; see docs/research.md, 'Translation settings'. options override the model's Ollama defaults; presence_penalty is pinned to 0 because some models ship 1.5, which penalizes the tags and glossary terms a translation must repeat.
